title: 每 N 步生成预览图

standard.summary: 每隔 N 步使用当前 LoRA 权重生成预览图，用于监控训练进度。0 = 不生成预览。
standard.effect: 设为 50 = 每 50 步生成一组预览图保存到输出目录。可以直观看到 LoRA 在不同步数的学习效果。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练（>200步）推荐开启，帮助判断最佳停止点（防止过拟合后才发现）。
standard.avoidWhen: 生成预览会暂停训练约 5~30 秒（取决于生成步数和分辨率），频率过高会浪费训练时间。建议不超过每 50 步一次。

standard_en.summary: Generates a preview image with the current LoRA weights every N steps, to monitor progress. 0 = no previews.
standard_en.effect: Set to 50 = a set of previews saved to the output directory every 50 steps. It shows directly what the LoRA has learned at different step counts.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended on a long run (>200 steps), as it helps judge the best stopping point (rather than noticing overfitting only afterwards).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Generating a preview pauses training for roughly 5~30 seconds (depending on the step count and resolution), so too high a frequency wastes training time. No more often than every 50 steps is advisable.

advanced.principle: 每 N 步后暂停优化器，使用 eval 模式运行 DDIM/DPM 等采样器生成固定 prompt 的图像，然后恢复训练。sample_at_first = 是否在第 0 步（训练前）也生成一张作为基准对比。sample_cfg 控制生成时的 CFG 强度。
advanced.tradeoffs: 生成预览使用训练器的 GPU，会短暂打断 GPU 的训练计算流。batch 越大、采样步数越多，预览越耗时。建议 sample_num_steps 设为 20~25（快速采样）。

advanced_en.principle: Every N steps it pauses the optimizer, runs a DDIM/DPM-class sampler in eval mode to generate fixed-prompt images, then resumes training. sample_at_first = whether to also generate one at step 0 (before training) as a baseline comparison. sample_cfg controls the CFG strength at generation time.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Preview generation uses the trainer's GPU and briefly interrupts the GPU's training compute stream. The larger the batch and the more sampling steps, the longer the preview takes. Recommend sample_num_steps of 20~25 (fast sampling).
